subject: Full Stack AI Engineer (React + LLM/agentic apps) – NY / Fort Mill – Aaron Ramirez (C2C)
body:
Hi Rajeev,

I'm interested in the Full Stack AI/ML Engineer 12+ month contract (New York / Fort Mill hybrid). My tailored resume is attached.

- 10+ years building enterprise React/TypeScript platforms at Walmart Global Tech, IBM/AEP, and HCSC.
- Hands-on LLM application work: a GenAI seller-support assistant on the Claude API / LangChain at Walmart, Azure AI Services for field-note summarization at AEP, and RAG/agentic workflows with Claude Code and Cursor daily.
- Node.js and Python REST APIs, AWS/Azure, Docker, CI/CD, and observability for production AI features.
- Open to hybrid in New York or Fort Mill.

To be clear up front: my depth is React and application-layer AI integration rather than ML model training or MLOps. If the client needs a React-led engineer who can integrate LLM features end to end, I'd be a strong fit. Do you accept C2C, or is this W2 with TN support? Glad to talk this week.
